description: This file defines a custom exception class 'CashierNotFoundException' used in the Fineract project, specifically within the 'teller' module, to indicate that a cashier with a specified ID was not found.

classes.name: CashierNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a cashier resource was not found, extending a generic 'not found' exception.

methods.name: CashierNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific cashier ID, message code, and default message.
